name: Qiū Nuóyà
source: The owner of Philo, a flower shop. He's also Xavier's friend. Aside from selling flowers, he has a lot of "skills" such as creating new identities and manipulating data so MC could enter the N109 Zone. Where did Xavier meet such a friend?
